author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000140059
annotation to GO:0005773 vacuole
* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Q92820 GGH Gamma-glutamyl hydrolase and orthologs
l(3)72Dp Q8IQM9 fly
l(3)72Dr Q9VV00 fly
* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Currently, the GO term vacuole is used for the IBA based on a plant entry. It’s not really wrong based on the GO definition but I think for animals it would make more sense to use the annotation associated with the human entry (Q92820) to extracellular region and lysosome GO terms for annotation.
title: PAINT issue: PTN000140059 vacuole annotation
